note: Rewritten from the English diagnostic characters of the second species entry in Rathore & Tak (State Fauna Series 8: Fauna of Gujarat, Insecta: Isoptera); Caste known lists the alate, the soldier and the pseudoworker, but the original describes only the soldier and the pseudoworker, the alate not being treated; the pseudoworker is placed in the Worker section of this entry and noted in the text. The measurements are kept verbatim in mm.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier head capsule generally dark brown, almost black anteriorly, short and thick with a truncate (phragmotic) frons; eyes small but present; antennae 11—15-segmented; mandibles short and stout, triangular, markedly convex, each with 2 weak to distinct marginal teeth; total body length 3.8—6.2 mm. Pseudoworker head and body pale yellow, head capsule nearly circular, with eye spots, antennae 12—14-segmented, total body length 4.4—6.0 mm.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule generally dark brown, almost black anteriorly; short and thick, the frons truncate, the head used to plug the gallery opening (phragmotic). Eyes present, rather small, oval. Antennae 11—15-segmented. Mandibles short, stout, triangular, markedly convex, each with 2 weak to distinct marginal teeth. Total body length 3.8—6.2 mm; greatest head width 1.08—1.37 mm. Pronotum slightly narrower than to slightly wider than the head: length 0.70—0.90 mm, width 1.00—1.30 mm. Abdomen hairy, elongate-oval.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Pseudoworker (pseudoworker in the original). Head and body pale yellow, sparsely hairy. Total body length 4.4—6.0 mm. Head capsule nearly circular. With eye spots. Antennae 12—14-segmented. Pronotum narrower than the head capsule: length 0.53—0.66 mm, width 0.97—1.00 mm.
